clean_story:
"Building blocks. Dynamic pages. React is a JavaScript library for crafting user interfaces, like assembling Lego pieces to build a house instead of sculpting it from clay.

JavaScript powers the whole construction site, while React organizes the bricks. Without JavaScript, React does nothing. Without React, JavaScript builds slower, manual structures.

Three related subjects are virtual DOM, component reuse and web frameworks."
